	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',

	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupERDBTidalJobHistoryLKPTABLE
InputPlaceHolderJobHistoryVariableSource,LookupERDBTidalJobHistoryLKPTABLE lookup(InputPlaceHolderJobHistoryVariableSource@JobRunID == LookupERDBTidalJobHistoryLKPTABLE@JobRunID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupERDBTidalJobHistory

		Duration,

		JobStatusID,
